title: Implementation and project details in the spec (C1)
planted_problem: Three scope problems: a storage technology choice (AWS S3 bucket), a library choice (Sharp), and project-management content (who builds it and by when).

expected_findings.expected_issue: names a storage technology instead of the observable behavior
names an implementation library; the observable behavior is the 256 by 256 size
an assignment and deadline belong in plan or task artifacts, not in the product spec

must_not_flag.reason: file types and size limit are product constraints the user can observe, not implementation details

forbidden_revision_behaviors: replacing S3 or Sharp with another named technology
dropping the 256 by 256 size or the 5 MB limit
expected_revision_behavior: FR-002 and FR-003 are restated as observable behavior (keeping 256 by 256), with a note or marker that the mechanism belongs in the plan; FR-005 is removed from the requirements or marked as belonging in the plan
